content.value: Examine that the lines $\textstyle { \frac { x - 1 } { 2 } } = { \frac { y - 2 } { 3 } } = { \frac { z - 3 } { 4 } } { \mathrm { a n d ~ } } { \frac { x - 2 } { 3 } } = { \frac { y - 4 } { 4 } } = { \frac { z - 5 } { 5 } }$ are coplanar or not. If coplanar, then find the equation of plane containing them. If not, then find the shortest distance and equation of shortest distance between them.
